subject: Tenant ownership transfer & offer bundling: preflight questions
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@baysidecloud.com>, mpn-onboard@microsoft.com
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Tenant ownership transfer & offer bundling: preflight questions

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week — excited to help Bayside get live on the Azure Marketplace and pursue co-sell. Before we schedule the technical handoff with Marketplace, we have a few preflight items that will unblock publication and co-sell certification. I pasted them below so we can collect answers and attachments in one place.

Quick context: Bayside wants to (a) transfer publisher ownership into your corporate tenant (Partner Center) so you control billing/identity, and (b) publish a bundled offer that exposes a SaaS SKU plus an optional managed-support SKU.

Preflight questions / asks:
- Publisher/tenant ownership
  - Do you already have an active Partner Center / commercial marketplace publisher tenant ID? If so, please share the publisher ID (GUID).
  - If ownership transfer is required, do you have an internal owner who can approve tenant-verified identity (MPN profile/KYC)?
- Offer bundling
  - Confirm desired offer type: SaaS (single-tenant SaaS) vs Managed Application vs Offer with add-ons. We need this to set the manifest fields correctly.
  - Attached is a first-pass manifest for the SaaS bundle (bayside-offer-manifest-v1.json). Please review the SKU naming and billing model.
- Technical validation items
  - SSO / SAML: will Bayside manage auth (SAML IDP) for end customers or will Redwood handle auth tokens?
  - API endpoints: confirm endpoints and any IP allowlist requirements for Azure validation.
  - Telemetry & privacy: any customer data residency or telemetry redaction needs?
- Co-sell & marketplace readiness
  - Co-sell: do you want Redwood to be listed as co-sell partner or would Bayside own the co-sell relationship?
  - Case study / logos: do you have a short logo + 2-line blurb we can include in the offer listing?

Attachments: bayside-offer-manifest-v1.json (attached)

Suggested next step: quick 30-min technical preflight with Marketplace + our Platform Engineers to walk through the manifest and ownership transfer flow. I'm available Mon/Tue morning PST.

Thanks — Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189
Redwood Inference — inference you can ship

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@baysidecloud.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenant ownership transfer & offer bundling: preflight questions

Diego —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers below and I attached our SOW for scope alignment.

- Publisher/tenant ownership
  - We do have a Partner Center tenant: Publisher ID 8f4a2d7e-3c1a-4f7b-9b2a-2e3c7b9d6b12.
  - I'll be the publisher admin and can complete identity verification; our legal will sign any publisher transfer SOW if required.
- Offer bundling
  - Prefer Redwood to publish the SaaS offer under Bayside's tenant and list Redwood as co-sell partner (co-sell preferred). The add-on managed-support SKU should be a purchasable add-on.
- Technical validation
  - SSO: Bayside will manage customer SAML SSO at tenant level. Redwood will integrate via OIDC for service-to-service tokens.
  - Endpoints: we will provide public endpoints and a CIDR range to allowlist for Azure validation.
  - Data residency: EU customers require data to live in West Europe — we'll mark that in the manifest.
- Co-sell
  - Bayside prefers Redwood listed as co-sell partner. We will send a short blurb and logo after legal approval.

Attachments: SOW (sow-redwood-marketplace.pdf)

Next step: a short call tomorrow (Mon) at 10:30am PST works for me. If that's okay, please send a calendar invite with the Marketplace onboarding link.

Cheers,
Sarah

--
Sarah Lin
Head of Partnerships | Bayside Cloud
sarah.lin@baysidecloud.com | +1 (206) 555-0190

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@baysidecloud.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenant ownership transfer & offer bundling: preflight questions

Thanks Sarah — helpful context. A few clarifications from the engineering/marketplace side and a proposed checklist to keep the onboarding tight.

Key clarifications:
- Publisher transfer vs publisher-adjacent publishing: Since Bayside will retain the Partner Center tenant ID, our suggested flow is that Bayside creates the offer under their tenant and adds Redwood as a co-sell/reseller contact. This avoids transfer of ownership and speeds approval. If you still prefer a transfer of publisher ownership, we can coordinate, but that route usually adds a 2–3 week identity verification step.
- Offer manifest notes: we'll update the manifest to include a region constraint for the West Europe data residency requirement and convert the managed-support SKU to an "add-on" type in the offer JSON.

Preflight checklist (what we'll bring to the call):
- Confirm publisher ID and primary admin (Sarah) — DONE
- Updated manifest (we'll push v2 before the call) — ACTION: Redwood (Rishi)
- IP allowlist + endpoints doc — ACTION: Bayside (Sarah)
- Co-sell paperwork & logo / blurb — ACTION: Bayside legal/marketing
- Marketplace onboarding link & verification steps — ACTION: Redwood (Soojin)

Proposed call slots (Pacific): Mon 2026-11-23 10:30 or 14:00; Tue 2026-11-24 09:00–12:00. I'll block 30 minutes for the technical preflight and invite Rishi from infra and Lauren for product alignment.

Quick references: Azure publisher onboarding guide: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Marketplace/PublisherOffersBlade

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Director, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
